title: Publish a post on social channels
description: Creates a post with social_post_create_v1 on the explicit channel ids of the caller (draft, scheduled or immediate). The publication identifier is the idempotency key. The journal is written at requested before the call. Requires a manual confirmation.

publication_id.description: Publication identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Derived from the request when absent; also the idempotency key of a social post

channels.description: Channel ids of the social service (1 to 10), as a list or comma separated

source_path.description: Storage path of a .md or .txt file used as the text, instead of content

media_paths.description: Storage paths of up to 4 images (png, jpg, gif, webp)

schedule_at.description: RFC 3339 date in the future, required with mode schedule

confirmation_manuelle.description: Manual confirmation: oui (or true) to proceed

resend_after_unknown.description: oui to send again a publication whose outcome is unknown (requested or outcome_unknown); noted in the history

attempt.description: Attempt number (2 to 99) appended to a derived publication_id, to publish the same request again after a removal
